Native batches: admission64/fresh16/cycle1. WASM batches: admission64/fresh64 (one when the first loop count is at least 256)/cycle1. Fresh runs immediately resume every public yield; cycle additionally saves/restores at quantum one. Both include protocol encoding and outcome decoding. No exclusive-host claim.

supersededEvidence.disposition: Rejected economic preference for a condition-read-to-jump substitution after a live prefix. Initial failures remain attributed to their original candidate.

measurementNotes: Frozen P18 semantic and structural controls are distinct and measured separately. The original cell-prefix fixture is retained as a fallback: its final image is the structural P01 baseline, so two structural flag comparisons are exact image matches, not fabricated timings.

Three alternating independently launched process windows, plus two confirmations for suspected regressions; each process uses three warmups and nine samples. Final timing starts after this task’s builds and untimed probes stopped. No exclusive-host claim.
Branch-local cell allocation is a distinct source fixture; it does not rename or replace the original cell-prefix case. Both remain in the final matrix.

Native instruction observations prove dynamic selector tests fall from N to one and allocations/writes remain N. The shared pipeline may independently eliminate an unused read. Slot substitution is identity within mutually exclusive copies of one activation; all internal edges remain within the selected copy.

Fixed code/admission costs remain, including medium-size WASM allocation workloads. No universal speedup is claimed. Memory is working payload, not RSS; quantum-one and quantum-64 cycles remain separate.
All 18 Agent images remain unchanged. Earlier cumulative consumer measurements and pending M3/P13/P16/P18 decisions retain their exact original scope.
